Small. Straight line. High speed.
The Pentagon released the video.
The case is still officially unresolved.

frases: In March 2026, eight members of Congress asked the Pentagon for fifty-one UFO records.
The Pentagon found material on a classified network.
This video was one of them.
It shows a glowing object near an airport in Kazakhstan.
The Pentagon says it was filmed on a phone and edited before it was uploaded.
Real, or not?
